item.title: OpenCode on Your Phone: Remote Sessions with Tailscale and the Web App as a PWA
item.description: OpenCode has no mobile app, and it doesn't need one: the server already running on your desktop serves its own web UI, and that UI installs as a PWA. This is how I reach it from my phone over Tailscale, with HTTPS and nothing exposed to the internet.
item.dc:creator: Pablo Caro

item.title: From OpenCode in the terminal to OpenCode Desktop (on Linux)
item.description: I've been using OpenCode in the terminal for months. Now I'm trying the desktop app on my personal Linux machine, with the same OpenCode Go subscription and without touching my config.
item.dc:creator: Pablo Caro
